mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_supplier_delivery_stats (supplier_id, p_num, total_orders, on_time_orders, late_orders, avg_delivery_days, avg_delay_days, last_delivery_date, create_time, modified_time) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{pNum}, #{totalOrders}, #{onTimeOrders}, #{lateOrders}, #{avgDeliveryDays}, #{avgDelayDays}, #{lastDeliveryDate}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_orders = #{totalOrders}, on_time_orders = #{onTimeOrders}, late_orders = #{lateOrders}, avg_delivery_days = #{avgDeliveryDays}, avg_delay_days = #{avgDelayDays}, last_delivery_date = #{lastDeliveryDate}, modified_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_supplier_delivery_stats WHERE total_orders > 0 AND (on_time_orders / total_orders) < #{threshold} ORDER BY (on_time_orders / total_orders) ASC
